notes.title: Another demo version released
notes.notes: [p]I've released another version of the demo - 0.29.3 This one contains two major features as planned and a number of fixes. [/p][p][/p][p]Here are the features:[/p][list][*][p]Pickpocketing[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved stealth and stealth detection UI[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These are the last planned features that I'm going to include in the demo. From now on I'll work on the full game - mostly world building, writing dialog and lore, level design and NPC/boss encounter design. I also need to work on adding new player weapons, cybernetics and equipment.[/p][p][/p][p]The major systems in the game are complete and tested, but they'll likely evolve as development continues and will need fixes and support. [/p][p][/p][p]But all in all things are going well! Cheers, folks - I hope you have a lovely weekend![/p][p][/p][p]Svet[/p]

notes.title: New Demo version released
notes.notes: [p]I've released a new build of the demo (0.26.0-demo). It contains various fixes and features. One notable new features is the lock picking support - go ahead and give it a try![/p][p][/p][p]I've toned down the difficulty a bit and added some more enemies in the world. I'm looking forward for any feedback from players in the Steam Community forums or in the discord. [/p][p][/p][p]I'm planning to add two more features to the demo by the end of July:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Stealing/pickpocketing support.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved stealth detection with a visibility indicator, detection delay and animation.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]After those two are added the plan is to continue development and design of the main game. [/p][p][/p][p]Cheers and have a great week, folks![/p]
